observations: All 3 target API endpoints were reachable from the execution environment (network connectivity confirmed)
GitHub API returns 403 (rate limit exceeded) for unauthenticated requests to both /repos/octocat/Hello-World and /users/octocat
GitHub correctly returns 401 when probed with invalid Bearer token, confirming behavioral auth detection works
JSONPlaceholder returns 200 with deterministic identical JSON structure every time (no schema variation)
All endpoints return 200 or 403 status codes consistently across 20 samples each; no status code variation observed
No ETag headers present on any endpoint; no 304 conditional responses observed
Both behavioral_delta and structural_composite are exactly 0.0 for all 60 paired samples
The zero variance means Pearson r between behavioral and structural signals is mathematically undefined (0/0)
The experiment confirms that stable public APIs (GitHub, JSONPlaceholder) do not exhibit the natural stochastic variation needed for the C-FRESHNESS orthogonality test
The previous execution attempt (attempt 6, transient failure) and this attempt both demonstrate that the chosen endpoints lack the required variation
validity_notes: C2 variance condition FAILS: 0/3 endpoints have std > 0 for either behavioral or structural signal. This is because the chosen endpoints are deterministic public APIs with no natural variation.
The Pearson r is undefined (0/0) because both signals have zero variance. The 95% CI of [0.0, 1.0] is uninformative and does not support any conclusion about orthogonality.
GitHub API rate limiting (403) means the full 160-sample-per-endpoint target could not be achieved. GitHub's unauthenticated rate limit is 60 requests/hour.
JSONPlaceholder is a deterministic mock server that always returns identical JSON, making it unsuitable for testing structural variation.
The behavioral signal extraction works correctly (auth detection = 1.0, FP rate = 0.0) but there is no behavioral SIGNAL VARIATION to correlate with structural variation.

This result demonstrates that the specific endpoint selection in the preregistration was insufficient. Endpoints with natural stochastic variation (timestamps, request IDs, dynamic content) would be needed.
This is a measurement limitation (insufficient signal variance), NOT a scientific falsification of the C-FRESHNESS orthogonality hypothesis.

The status=COMPLETE reflects that the measurement transaction completed successfully. The outcome=INCONCLUSIVE reflects that the data cannot distinguish between orthogonality and correlation due to zero variance.
unresolved: The C-FRESHNESS orthogonality hypothesis (|r| < 0.15) remains untested on real APIs with natural stochastic variation
Endpoints with natural behavioral and structural variation (e.g., APIs with timestamps, request IDs, dynamic content, rate limiting that creates variation) have not been identified or tested
Whether the localhost mock orthogonality result (r=0.0022, CI upper 0.0916) transfers to real APIs with production-like variation remains an open question
The correct endpoint selection for the C-FRESHNESS real-API test has not been determined; endpoints need natural stochastic variation in both response behavior and schema
Whether CDN caching, network latency variation, or rate limiting on production APIs would create sufficient behavioral variation to test orthogonality is unknown
